column3: descended by a part, carried off by him
protecting the Vedas swallowed up by time
time approached, divided into three-nine-four yugas
this time is meaningful/ bringing results
being driven like one without protector
some, with sorrow caused by it, sighs, faces faded in beauty
from the quarters the water rose north
you will soon reach the goal
of the servant who does not know
with a garland of small bells
like a slightly dull, mad, ghoul
among worlds of lords doers something
wishing to say something, came here
what can be through good deeds
something cast away in the forest
slightly faded in beauty, face down
wind with tulasi pollen mixed with filaments
surrounded by Kinnaras, Gandharvas and apsaras
what did he do in Mathura
of what use is the quality-less
what do I ... (what does he wish)
what should be done by us
what, inside and outside covered, by the elephant's birth
the Self doing something, the mind established in the Self not
what by half of the Self
what is unobtainable for the Endless
what is, marked by "is" and "is not"
what is this of the Lord by us
what by us forest-dwellers or other women
and what of the Self here
what by Indra of little valour
what then with others, wealth and so on
what then of those who touch with a glance
what is this, a boar's pretext
what is this wonder as it were
what is this, the form of man-lion
what by these trifles of the Self
how much is this conquest of the Self, liberation is in conquest of the Self
how much I wished like a spark in fire
one whose crown is touched by the dust of pure feet
with thousand hoods wildly shining by thousand crown-jewels
adorned with crown, necklace, bracelet, waist-thread, armlets
with kirtan, poetry and sweet music
the fame of qualities and stories to be sung
narrate what is to be sung
of him of magnanimous deeds worthy of praise
of the sung and holy, sins removed by inner and outer bathing
by fame, victory and all prosperities
served by fame, victory and all prosperities
by song of fame rising up
of the elephant-lord's, the wife of Janaka's daughter... (Sita)
from the death of the evil body
intestines and veins of the belly
body smeared with saffron from the breasts
(they) arranged a seat for their kinsman, marked with saffron from breasts
garlands disturbed on the breasts, saffron...
attended by multitude of curly locks
with tangled, tawny, matted hair in heavy burden shaken, dirty
among those who say the body is the self
to be enjoyed as a corpse
(they) desire what is to be enjoyed as a corpse
by acts of charity like ponds and wells
enjoyed by pairs of earrings and locks of curls
the beauty of face enjoyed by pairs of earrings and locks of curls
nectar of the cheek-region splendour of earrings and lips
from the sacrificial pit, an embodied very terrible one
from anywhere at any time, O Lord
... with eyes bitten by serpent-like evil body
in a guise of garlands of jasmine, with curiosity
with a bad cloth tied round the waist
of those on the wrong path
of those who teach wrong paths
with brows shaking, with angry laughter
by the quivering of brows with angry laughter
bad-minded one, not knowing the Lord's proof
by the ripening of bad counsel
disturbed in mind for the boy
the boys, the elder too, this
with prosperity of night lotus, blue lotus, white lotus, hundred-petalled lotus forests
radiant with glory of night lotus, blue lotus, white lotus and hundred-petalled lotus
by the Kurus approaches with unfailing devotion-yoga
by the Kurus, Bhishma, Drona, Arjuna and others
the king of the Kurus repented
having taken leave of the elders of the Kurus
of the Kurus by dissension arisen within
one should accomplish the three aims
should do fasting and the like
should do for whom body etc. exists
the wise should act likewise, unattached, wishing public welfare
should perform the daily and occasional rites
should do by mind, speech, hands
should do in mind of the one saluted by all worlds
even a mantra spoken would do
of one who does with single-minded devotion
doing the raising of the sacrifice
doing, destroying the evil by enjoyments
equal to himself in family, character, beauty, learning, age, wealth, power
in the valleys of the chief mountains
this nest, friends and dear ones
this nest, friend, dear one, moves
as if the ignorant like the cry of a sparrow
the lotus within the sheath of lotus-bud
with kusha, deerskin and the like
called Kulaka by experts in welfare
of those mixed with good and evil
by good conduct of these here
with bad and good as provisions
seated on a seat spread with kusha grass
placing a flower arrow on the bow
sung by the followers of spring
loosened by the speed of the flower arrow
rows of flowering forest, humming bees...
flowering forest rows, bees, birds sounding lakes, rivers and mountains
embraced with flowers by the mind
wise should do, not attached, wishing world welfare
